mapper.select: SELECT recommendation_id recommendationId,override_json overrideJson,admin_username adminUsername,created_at createdAt,updated_at updatedAt FROM tw_h5_recommend_override WHERE recommendation_id=#{recommendationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tw_h5_recommend_override(recommendation_id,override_json,admin_username,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{recommendationId},#{overrideJson},#{adminUsername},NOW(),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE override_json=VALUES(override_json),admin_username=VALUES(admin_username),updated_at=NOW()
